data.title: Ranking is tuned against a golden set, and the set overruled the plan
data.why: Two ranking changes were planned. Only one survived measurement. Carrying a document title into every one of its sections was right: a section headed Consequences inside ADR-006 knew nothing of the phrase that says what the document decides, and adding it moved recall@3 from 0.60 to 0.64. Query expansion by relevance feedback - take the first answers, borrow the distinctive words, ask again - was the interesting idea and it lost: 0.60 at every weight and feedback size tried, and three times the cost of a query, because when the first answers are wrong the borrowed words make them wronger. What did work was duller: BM25 length normalization at 0.45 instead of 0.75, because these units run from a forty-character note to a two-kilobyte section and the standard value assumes one kind of document. That is 0.68. The set also had to be widened first - twelve questions became twenty-five - because several of the twelve repeated the words of their own answer, and a measure that easy cannot tell tuning from luck.
data.rejected: Query expansion from corpus co-occurrence: measured worse at every setting, and three times slower. Kept as a note rather than as code.; Tuning on the original twelve questions: the scale was too coarse to distinguish an improvement from noise, and too easy to be honest.
